title: Deadlift Focus 10 Week
author: LegendOfTadpole
desc: Unlock your strength with the 10-Week Deadlift First Powerlifting Program! Designed for dedicated lifters, this 4-day weekly regimen focuses on building your deadlift prowess while enhancing overall powerlifting skills. Each week is strategically crafted to increase your strength and technique, ensuring you progress steadily towards your goals. Whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your lifts, this program will empower you to lift heavier and achieve new personal records. Get ready to transform your training and dominate the platform!
